name_en: Kanzaki somen — hand-stretched wheat noodles from Kanzaki, chilled and dipped
summary_ja: 神埼特産の手延べそうめんを氷水でしめ、コシとつるりとした喉ごしを楽しむ。約380年前、諸国を巡っていた僧が病に倒れた際、看病した行商人に製法を伝えたのが始まりと伝わる。
summary_en: Hand-stretched somen noodles from Kanzaki are chilled in ice water for a firm bite and smooth slide — said to trace back some 380 years to a traveling monk who, falling ill, taught the noodle-making craft to the peddler who nursed him.
source_title: 冷やしそうめん 佐賀県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
